newsitem.title: USA: Cable and Wireless offers San Diego service.
newsitem.headline: Cable and Wireless offers San Diego service.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Inc said it introduced local and long distance telephone service for businesses in the San Diego area.

The unit of Cable and Wireless Plc said it now offers the combined local and long distance service in New York City, Connecticut, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco and San Diego. The company said it is authorized to provide the combined service in Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Texas and Wisconsin.
Cable & Wireless said it plans to offer a similar service in Miami by February 1997.
